Package hkust.marketplace.service

Class Marketplace

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.service.Marketplace
public class Marketplace extends Object
Creates and wires every service around one data store and clock. Screens get services from here, so the Seller (Task 2) and Admin (Task 3) portals share the same rules and data.
